title: 第3章 单挑第4章 当幸福来敲门
content_zh:
第三章 单挑
拜纳姆微微一愣，用力一拍手，大叫道：“我知道你！你是UCLA的饿狼！你不是被雷劈了吗？哦……抱歉。”
原来我也是名人，或者该说是有名的衰人，叶锋苦笑道：“对，我就是那个遭雷劈的家伙，刚出院不久，想找人活动一下筋骨，所以我来球馆看看。”
拜纳姆哈哈大笑：“真是你啊！我喜欢橄榄球，还去看过你们的比赛。你太狠了，亚利桑那州立大学的跑锋被你撞飞翻了两个跟头，那家伙脖子好像都断了。还有斯坦福那个吃了你一记肘击的家伙，我看他被抬出场的时候都蒙上了白布！”
我擦，这算是夸奖吗？叶锋不知道该不该高兴。既然拜纳姆认识他，事情就更好办了。
拜纳姆指着旁边的黑人介绍道：“这位是我的表兄托马斯，伙计……你当陪练的话，不会抱摔我吧？那在篮球场上可是犯规的。”
叶锋翻了个白眼。“放心，我懂篮球规则，能和未来的全明星球员打球，是我的荣幸。”
“你觉得我能成为全明星？”拜纳姆哈哈大笑，兴奋的攥紧了拳头，他现在不过是个7.8分5.9篮板的角色球员，而他的目标就是成为全明星球员。
叶锋知道未来，拜纳姆会进步的，他在2012年入选了西部全明星首发。如果不是受伤病影响，也许他会做的更好。他笑道：“对，我认为你行。如果你场均出场达到35分钟，多点出手机会，我想你的数据应该能达到15分10篮板的两双水准，而且你在防守端很有威慑力，打首发比夸梅.布朗好得多。我是老球迷，看人很准，你迟早会成为全明星的。”
拜纳姆喜欢听到鼓励的话，用力和叶锋握了握手，笑道:“谢谢。很高兴见到你。”
“我也是。”
两人谈起了陪练的事，湖人助理教练“天钩”贾巴尔是拜纳姆的师傅，他要求拜纳姆主要练习低位的背身进攻和勾手投篮，拜纳姆现在的低位技术很烂，得分主要依靠跳投。拉到高位，他的策应进攻能力又达不到教练要求，这样的中锋是无法统治内线的。为了在NBA闯出名堂，拜纳姆放弃了假期。他当然想找陪练，但能把他抗在三秒区外的内线球员并不是很好找，现在叶锋找上门来正合他的心意，橄榄球运动员的力量都很强，何况是UCLA有名的“饿狼”呢？
拜纳姆晃了晃肩膀，笑道：“来试试吧，你要在后面抗住我，让我无法轻松转身。托马斯，你来传球。”
“好，我先做准备活动。”叶锋嘴上说的轻松，其实激动的心脏都快从嗓子眼跳出来了。就在一天前，还是个“狗仔队”成员，能做NBA球员的陪练简直像做梦一样。这可不是和普通人打着玩，2007年拜纳姆也已经是成为先发的内线球员了，他的潜力早得到了专家肯定。
能够重生太幸运了，以前的我想给拜纳姆提包也没机会啊，这简直是上帝的恩赐。叶锋深吸了一口气，脱掉T恤，光了膀子，呈现出完美的肌肉线条，胸肌壮硕，腹肌完美，充满爆炸力的长臂，右臂的狼头刺青格外扎眼，他给人的感觉就像一个永远也不会被打倒的战士。他线绕着球场慢跑了一圈，然后进行了两组冲刺跑。
纵使拜纳姆已经打了两个赛季也看的目瞪口呆，因为实在太快了。科比也没有这么强的爆发力！他楞道：“你一百米速度多少？”
叶锋不知道，他大约估计了一下，笑道：“不知道，很久没测过一百米了，大概十一秒左右吧。”
拜纳姆咽了口吐沫，压力倍增，面对橄榄球选手，他必须打出水准。叶锋是没有压力的，就算防不住也很正常，不丢人。
两人都站到了三秒区右侧的45度角，这是内线球员最喜欢要球的位置，背身拿球时视野开阔，吸引包夹后也容易找到空当传球。
拜纳姆鼓足了力气要位，托马斯把球吊了过来。拜纳姆的身高达到了213CM，叶锋只有两米左右，看起来比他小了一号，但是他运了两步就发现叶锋的力量超出想象，在他的撞击下几乎纹丝不动，两条腿如同钉在地板上一样。

我的上帝，感觉就像在撞墙，拜纳姆简直怀疑身后防守的是本.华莱士。
此刻叶锋有种如鱼得水的感觉。科学研究表明，人的肌肉也是有记忆力的，和拜纳姆一较劲，他有种说不出的舒畅。开始他还有点紧张，现在信心又暴增上来了，抗住拜纳姆比他想像的要容易，当然这不是拜纳姆弱，而是他太强壮。在橄榄球场上，他经常要经受对方截锋的正面全力冲击，那是放低身子的肉搏，背身碰撞相比之下是小儿科。
拜纳姆带球往中路移动，叶锋马上就贴了上去，挡住了行进路线。他的反应迅速，不需要动脑，是长期打橄榄球练出的条件反射。以前他要防守的是些爆发力超强的跑锋，要跟上那些人的速度还要进行擒抱，谈何容易？要跟上拜纳姆的速度，对他来说也太容易了。
我要是连业余选手都打不了，怎么成为明星啊？拜纳姆心里有点不是滋味，他改变了策略，带球往左侧轻轻一晃，叶锋重心跟着移动，拜纳姆立即向反方向转身，叶锋追上想封盖，拜纳姆依住叶锋，让他跳不起来，利用了身高优势单手抛投打板命中。
叶锋拍手笑道：“漂亮。”
“你防的也很好。”拜纳姆也真心的赞叹。这一球他投的很满意，也感到了防守的压迫性，就这一次进攻，他已经决定请叶锋当陪练了。
打了几个回合，拜纳姆渐渐摸清了叶锋的防守路数，他的缺点非常明显，很容易吃假动作。这是缺少比赛经验造成的，不过拜纳姆高兴不起来，不能硬吃比自己矮半头的人让他感到很不爽。
旁观者清，负责传球的托马斯只觉叶锋太猛了。虽然拜纳姆五次进攻进了四球，可全是躲着打，业余选手竟能凭身体把拜纳姆逼到这种份上。
叶锋也发现了自己的问题所在，他太过注意拜纳姆的假动作，其实只要贴住对方，不被过掉，抬手形成干扰会更好一些，他唯一一次防守成功就是这么来的。
拜纳姆停了下来，拿着球叹道：“UCLA的篮球队真应该请你去帮忙。我怀疑你能抗住大学里的所有内线。”
听对方夸奖，叶锋有些得意，陪练的工作看来到手了。“听你这么一说，我都想改打篮球了。防守来说，篮球比橄榄球容易一些。这样的身体对抗在橄榄球场上算不了什么。”
拜纳姆笑道：“再来。”
“我要更用力了，你要小心。”叶锋笑道。他想要换一种防守方式，他大体摸清了拜纳姆的进攻方式，往往都是先晃一下，然后往反方向转身，只要第一下不吃晃，就可以跟上。如果拜纳姆跳投，他就上前封眼干扰。封眼防守，是NBA很常见的防守方式，火箭队的巴蒂尔就很擅长，他想试试。如果拜纳姆往篮下突破，就看准机会盖帽。
虽然灵魂换了人，不过叶锋的好胜心早已经渗透进了骨髓里。只要是和对方较量，他就想赢。能够防下拜纳姆，是很有成就感的一件事。
这个家伙还没尽全力？拜纳姆不甘示弱，笑道：“那我也要打的用力些，你别客气。”
拜纳姆再在同一位置拿球，这一次，他发现叶锋在顶防他的时候，不是那么用力了。无论球员怎么做假动作，最后都要投篮，叶锋准备在他出手的时候封盖。
拜纳姆不知道对方的想法，他想打一次强硬的进攻，目标是突入内线扣篮。他先是背身往右侧轻轻晃了一下，然后迅速往底线转身，运球进到了篮下。这次转身比较轻松，他单手拿球迈了一步起跳扣篮。
叶锋这次并没有吃晃，他是主动让开的，快速退防到了篮下。见拜纳姆转身，他从侧面启动，迈出一步后高高跃起。
他这一跃就到了篮下，脑袋都差点撞上篮筐，他的左手准确的按在了篮球上……拜纳姆没想到叶锋会追上来封盖他的扣篮，只用了一半力气，右手对上叶锋左手也没占到便宜，一股大力袭来，拜纳姆身体失去了平衡，不但篮球被拍落，还狼狈的一屁股坐在了地上。
叶锋稳稳的落地，看着自己的手，有些不敢相信，感觉真太他妈爽了!

旁观的托马斯嘴巴张的能吞下个鸭蛋。在NBA赛场上，也很少有人能这样封盖拜纳姆，如果是比赛，这要上十佳球集锦了。
拜纳姆坐在地上，看着他皱眉道：“真不愧是饿狼，我注意力稍微不集中，差点被你玩死了。”
叶锋把他拉了起来，笑道：“抱歉，我都说让你小心一点了。”
拜纳姆苦笑道：“我觉得你选错职业了，橄榄球场上，你的弹跳力发挥不出来，该打篮球的。你平时有空吗？我想请你当长期陪练行吗？”
叶锋大喜，既赚钱，又锻炼身体的工作到手了。为了吃饭，他很现实的问道：“当然可以，你能给我多少钱？”
content_en:
Chapter 3 Duel
Bynum was slightly stunned, clapped his hands vigorously, and shouted: "I know you! You are the hungry wolf of UCLA! Weren't you struck by lightning? Oh... I'm sorry."
It turns out that I am also a celebrity, or should I say a famous loser. Ye Feng smiled bitterly and said: "Yes, I am the guy who was struck by lightning. I was just discharged from the hospital and wanted to find someone to stretch my muscles, so I came to the arena to have a look."
Bynum laughed loudly: "It's really you! I like football, and I went to your game. You were so cruel. The running back of Arizona State University was knocked over twice by you, and the guy's neck seemed to be broken. And the guy from Stanford who took your elbow, I saw that he was covered with a white cloth when he was carried off the field!"
Damn it, is this a compliment? Ye Feng didn't know whether he should be happy or not. Now that Bynum knows him, things will be easier.
Bynum pointed to the black man next to him and introduced: "This is my cousin Thomas, man... If you are a sparring partner, you won't hug and throw me, right? That is a foul on the basketball court."
Ye Feng rolled his eyes. "Don't worry, I understand the rules of basketball. It is an honor for me to play with future All-Star players."
"Do you think I can become an All-Star?" Bynum laughed and clenched his fists in excitement. He is now just a role player with 7.8 points and 5.9 rebounds, and his goal is to become an All-Star.
Ye Feng knows that Bynum will improve in the future. He was selected as a starter for the Western Conference All-Stars in 2012. If it weren't for the injury, maybe he would have done better. He smiled and said: "Yes, I think you can do it. If you average 35 minutes per game and have more shooting opportunities, I think your data should reach the double-double level of 15 points and 10 rebounds. Moreover, you are very intimidating on the defensive end and are much better as a starter than Kwame Brown. I am an old fan and I am very accurate in reading people. You will become an All-Star sooner or later."
Bynum liked to hear words of encouragement, so he shook hands with Ye Feng vigorously and said with a smile: "Thank you. Nice to meet you."
"Me too."
The two talked about sparring. Lakers assistant coach "Skyhook" Kareem Abdul-Jabbar was Bynum's master. He asked Bynum to mainly practice low post attacks and hook shots. Bynum's current low post skills are very poor, and he mainly relies on jump shots to score. Moved to a high position, his ability to support offense does not meet the coach's requirements. Such a center cannot dominate the inside. In order to make a name for himself in the NBA, Bynum gave up his vacation. Of course he wants to find a partner, but it's not easy to find an inside player who can keep him outside the three-second zone. Now Ye Feng has come to him, which is exactly what he wants. Rugby players are very strong, let alone the famous "Hungry Wolf" from UCLA?
Bynum shook his shoulders and said with a smile: "Let's try it. You have to resist me from behind so that I can't turn around easily. Thomas, you pass the ball."
"Okay, I'll do the preparatory activities first." Ye Feng said it casually, but in fact, his heart almost jumped out of his throat with excitement. Just a day ago, I was a member of the "paparazzi", and being a sparring partner for NBA players was like a dream. This is no joke with ordinary people. Bynum has already become a starting inside player in 2007, and his potential has long been recognized by experts.
I'm so lucky to be reborn. I never had the chance to carry Bynum's bag before. This is simply a gift from God. Ye Feng took a deep breath, took off his T-shirt, and went shirtless, showing perfect muscle lines, strong chest muscles, perfect abdominal muscles, explosive long arms, and the wolf head tattoo on his right arm that was particularly eye-catching. He gave people the impression of a warrior who would never be defeated. He jogged around the court and then did two sets of sprints.
Even though Bynum had played for two seasons, he was still stunned because it was so fast. Kobe is not that strong either.Work hard! He asked in shock: "What's your speed at 100 meters?"
Ye Feng didn't know. He made an estimate and said with a smile: "I don't know. It's been a long time since I measured 100 meters. It should be about eleven seconds."
Bynum swallowed and the pressure doubled. He had to perform at a high level when facing rugby players. There is no pressure on Ye Feng. Even if he cannot prevent it, it is normal and not embarrassing.
Both stood at a 45-degree angle on the right side of the three-second zone, which is the favorite position for inside players to ask for the ball. They have a wide field of vision when holding the ball with their backs, and it is easy to find space to pass the ball after attracting double-teams.
Bynum mustered up all his strength to gain position, and Thomas lobbed the ball over. Bynum's height reached 213cm, and Ye Feng was only about two meters tall. He looked one size smaller than him. However, after taking two steps, he discovered that Ye Feng's strength was beyond imagination. He could hardly move under his impact, and his legs felt like they were nailed to the floor.
My God, it felt like I was hitting a wall. Bynum almost doubted that the guy behind him was Ben Wallace.
At this moment, Ye Feng felt like a fish in water. Scientific research shows that human muscles also have memory. When he competes with Bynum, he feels indescribably comfortable. He was a little nervous at first, but now his confidence has surged. It is easier to resist Bynum than he thought. Of course, this is not because Bynum is weak, but because he is too strong. On the football field, he often has to withstand the full frontal impact of the opponent's tackle. It is a physical fight with a low body, and a back-to-back collision is child's play in comparison.
Bynum dribbled the ball toward the center, and Ye Feng immediately got up and blocked the path. His reaction is quick and does not require the use of his brain. It is a conditioned reflex developed by playing rugby for a long time. In the past, he had to defend some extremely explosive running backs. He had to keep up with those people's speed and had to make tackles. How easy was it? It's too easy for him to keep up with Bynum's speed.
How can I become a star if I can't even compete as an amateur? Bynum felt a little uncomfortable. He changed his strategy and dribbled the ball to the left. Ye Feng's center of gravity moved accordingly. Bynum immediately turned in the opposite direction. Ye Feng caught up with him and wanted to block the shot. Bynum held onto Ye Feng, preventing him from jumping up. He took advantage of his height advantage and hit the ball with a one-handed throw.
Ye Feng clapped his hands and smiled: "Beautiful."
"You defended very well." Bynum also sincerely praised. He was very satisfied with this shot and felt the pressure of the defense. For this offense, he had decided to ask Ye Feng to be his sparring partner.
After playing for several rounds, Bynum gradually figured out Ye Feng's defensive methods. His shortcomings were very obvious and he was prone to fake moves. This was caused by a lack of competition experience, but Bynum was not happy. He felt very unhappy that he could not forcefully defeat someone who was half a head shorter than himself.
It was clear to onlookers that Thomas, who was responsible for passing the ball, felt that Ye Feng was too fierce. Although Bynum scored four goals in five attacks, he was all dodging the ball. An amateur player could actually use his body to push Bynum to this point.
Ye Feng also discovered his problem. He paid too much attention to Bynum's fake moves. In fact, it would be better to stick to the opponent and not be passed by, and raise his hands to cause interference. This was his only successful defense.
Bynum stopped, held the ball and sighed: "UCLA's basketball team should really ask you to help. I doubt you can resist all the big men in the university."
Hearing the other party's compliments, Ye Feng felt a little proud, as he seemed to have got his sparring job. "Hearing what you say, I almost want to play basketball instead. Defensively, basketball is easier than football. Such physical confrontation is nothing on the football field."
Bynum smiled and said, "Come again."
"I'm going to work harder, you have to be careful." Ye Feng said with a smile. He wanted to change his defensive method. He roughly figured out Bynum's offensive method, which usually involved shaking first and then turning in the opposite direction. As long as he didn't stumble in the first shot, he could keep up. ifWhen Bynum made a jump shot, he stepped forward to block his eyes and interfere. Eye-sealing defense is a very common defensive method in the NBA. Battier of the Rockets is very good at it and he wants to try it. If Bynum breaks through to the basket, look for the opportunity to block the shot.
Although his soul has changed, Ye Feng's competitive spirit has already penetrated into his bones. As long as he competes with the opponent, he wants to win. Being able to guard Bynum is a very fulfilling thing.
Is this guy not trying his best? Not to be outdone, Bynum smiled and said, "Then I will hit harder, so you're welcome."
Bynum got the ball in the same position again. This time, he found that Ye Feng was not using so much force when guarding him. No matter how the player fakes, he has to shoot in the end, and Ye Feng is ready to block the shot when he takes the shot.
Bynum didn't know what the opponent was thinking. He wanted to play a tough attack, with the goal of breaking into the paint and dunking. He first turned his back and swayed slightly to the right, then quickly turned towards the baseline and dribbled into the basket. This time the turn was easier. He took the ball with one hand, took a step forward and dunked.
Ye Feng did not stumble this time. He took the initiative to get out of the way and quickly retreated to the basket. Seeing Bynum turn around, he started from the side, took a step and then jumped high.
He jumped to the basket, his head almost hit the basket, and his left hand accurately pressed on the basketball... Bynum did not expect that Ye Feng would catch up and block his dunk. He only used half of his strength, and his right hand did not take advantage of Ye Feng's left hand. A strong force came, and Bynum lost his balance. Not only was the basketball knocked down, but he also sat on the ground in embarrassment.
Ye Feng landed firmly and looked at his hands, somewhat unbelievable. It felt so damn good!
Thomas, who was watching, could open his mouth enough to swallow a duck egg. In the NBA, few people can block Bynum like this. If it were a game, this would be on the top ten highlights.
Bynum sat on the ground, looked at him and frowned: "As expected of a hungry wolf, I was a little distracted and you almost killed me."
Ye Feng pulled him up and said with a smile: "Sorry, I told you to be careful."
Bynum smiled bitterly and said: "I think you have chosen the wrong career. On the football field, your jumping ability cannot be used. You should play basketball. Are you usually free? I would like to ask you to be a long-term partner?"
Ye Feng was overjoyed to get a job that not only made money but also exercised his body. In order to eat, he asked realistically: "Of course, how much can you give me?"
